synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? He finds out that the Bennett sisters live in the apartment next door to his, and since Emma had taken to Akito, the Bennett sisters start coming over to Akito's place every day.
